_doc: Immutable shop-level data for SOMA test certificates. Field values transcribed verbatim from the TML-approved 04/02/26 certificate (5181_3240_4202.pdf). Original-document typos are preserved (e.g. 'Cynide', 'Brightner', 'Importer Coverage', 'Peef off', 'Ruse', 'final gating', 'Ginca', 'Rodiprind') because this format is approved by Tata Motors QA and any literal alteration requires QA-TML re-approval per the disclaimer.
